description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice Call for Claims to Land Parcels - Lankapura D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 120279
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title claims and registration processes under the Registration of Title Act. It involves notices calling for claims to specific land parcels in various villages, referencing cadastral maps, land ownership determinations, and land settlement procedures. The content focuses entirely on land and property matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters that would fall under other categories.
